note: B2B social content-system building blocks: the voice-foundation asset list, content-engine plays, repurposing targets (one newsletter section fanned out across channels), pinned-comment and video-script skeletons, the weekly creation/engagement/analytics rhythm, and outreach-tooling caps. Complements gtm/linkedin/templates.json (hook shapes, DM spine, sell-by-chat, warming stages live there — not duplicated here). This bank is authored, not measured — reach multipliers and reply figures are rules of thumb, and agents must not present anything here as 'proven'. A fuller playbook lives in the shared skills shelf as the b2b-social-gtm skill. Hard rules that travel with every row: platform terms prohibit unauthorized automation/scraping, every outbound item is a human-approved draft, caps are ceilings not targets, and voice/brief foundation files are private user context that is never published. Slots are UPPERCASE so an unfilled template trips the placeholder check in src/lib/services/deliverables/acceptance-contracts.ts.

foundationAssets.holds: positioning: who you help, what outcome, why you specifically
foundationAssets.readBy: every content and outreach generator, before anything is written

foundationAssets.holds: writing patterns: sentence length, vocabulary, rhythm, banned phrases
foundationAssets.readBy: every generator; the quality gap with vs without it is large

foundationAssets.holds: email-specific structure: opening, section format, CTA patterns
offer, exact ICP titles and signals, proof points with numbers, outreach history

contentPlays.how: generate ten hook candidates before writing any body; pick the strongest, then draft
cross topic areas with formats to bank roughly ninety post ideas, each tagged with track (proof, framework, story) and format
score a draft against the account's top performers, not generic best practice, before any high-stakes post
carousels and document posts tend to out-reach text-only posts by a wide margin (rule of thumb, not measured); produce the asset per post
track profile visits, connection requests, and DM conversations per post, not just likes; double down on the two best posts weekly
scan existing connections for ICP matches before hunting cold contacts; most operators already have hundreds
identify the ten to fifteen thought leaders the ICP already follows and the content gaps nobody owns; engage there consistently

skeletons.name: Pinned comment
skeletons.template: [ONE LINE THAT EXTENDS THE POST OR NAMES THE RESOURCE] [LINK TO THE LEAD MAGNET OR RESOURCE]
skeletons.why: Links in the post body suppress reach; the pinned comment carries the link instead. Under one hundred fifty characters, posted immediately after publishing, then pinned.

skeletons.name: Short-form video script
skeletons.template:
[COLD OPEN THAT DROPS INTO THE POINT MID ACTION]

[FIRST POINT WITH A SPECIFIC NUMBER OR EXAMPLE]
[SECOND POINT]
[THIRD POINT]

[ONE SENTENCE CTA]
skeletons.why: Thirty to sixty seconds; the cold open replaces any intro; three points maximum.

repurposeTargets.spec: 900-1300 characters, hook then body then CTA, no links in body
5-7 tweets, hook tweet first, one unit of value per tweet
30-60 seconds, cold open, three points, CTA
under 150 characters, carries the lead-magnet link for the LinkedIn post
five subject-line variants for the newsletter edition

weeklyRhythm.do: generate hooks, draft the week's three posts, score each against history, produce visuals, schedule for Tue/Thu/Sat
human-approved comments on 5-10 ICP accounts, reply to positive DMs, send 3-5 approved connection requests
review pipeline analytics, mine the best post's engagers for ICP matches, draft connection notes, repurpose the best post to other channels

toolingCaps.cap: dedup against the last 30 days so the same profile is never paid for twice
